facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_食神 (Water carrying The Artisan). Persona The Artisan (食神). Definition line: "Output that flows from you, giving that feels like being". Keyword Flow, charge gentle, poles catalyst Grace / friction Coasting. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: giving that feels like being; worth tangled with what is made. Arena: craft, hands, the table, warmth of making, fed and feeding. Classical portrait: ease and appetite; output that flows without assertion; generous, content, prone to drift and indulgence. Ruled domains: Expression, Enjoyment, Children. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 伤官.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water same-polarity — precision as natural source of flowing depth".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Artisan: a spring that feeds everything downstream. Your output flows, words, ideas, comfort, care, without visible effort, and people drink from it more than you notice. You nourish by permeating: the right thing said gently, the mood eased, the story that waters a dry week."
- k2_functional: "Your expression pours: fluent, warm, endlessly refilled. Writing and talk both come as flow."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Drifting","Indulgent","Unmoved"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Expression":"Your expression is the stream itself: writing, conversation, comfort flowing daily. Volume is natural to you, so add channels: publish, record, send. Water that reaches others is what turns gift to harvest.","Enjoyment":"You enjoy in gentle currents: long baths, slow music, conversation into the night. Honor these as necessities. A spring that is never let pool goes brackish.","Children":"With the young you nourish invisibly: the listening, the softening, the words that raise them without their noticing. They will quote you for life, usually without knowing whom they are quoting."}
- fn_reading.catalyst.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.catalyst; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 水_伤官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Silver-tongued","Inspired","Free-flowing"],"friction":["Toxic","Mocking","Uncontainable"]}
- Sibling cell 水_伤官 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Words obey you the way water obeys gravity, finding every gap and pouring through beautifully. You talk people into things, out of things, and around things, and they enjoy the ride even when they can see the technique. Persuasion this smooth stopped being learned long ago. It flows."

Core element Metal, energy element Water. Law: Metal feeds Water (金生水: dew beads on the cold blade). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Water is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Water on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Water as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_水's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
